title: Parapsychology master's program at John F. Kennedy University
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Parapsychology master's program at John F. Kennedy University, about c. 1980 at John F. Kennedy University, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: since I used to teach at John F. Kennedy University back in around 1980 uh when they had a master's degree in parasychology

plain: A psychologist and interviewer, Jeffrey Mishlove, says that around 1980 he taught at John F. Kennedy University in California, back when it offered a master's degree in parapsychology, the study of claimed psychic abilities. He mentions it to show that the field was once taught as a serious university subject.
